title: Morning Brief — Monday, 28 September 2026
description: Today's stories: the fallout from Saturday's AFL Grand Final and the Socceroos' thrilling draw with Brazil in Townsville, emergency dredging to save Queensland's Moore Park Beach, and Southport's marine rescue crew beginning a new chapter as part of Marine Rescue Queensland. 오늘의 브리핑은 영어에 이어 한국어로도 제공됩니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
